offer.product: Crea Rush Creatine HCl with BCAA and Taurine
offer.basis: Exact manufacturer product and retail pack, ordinary INR listed price and selected stock reviewed on 20 November 2026. Label amounts are manufacturer declarations, not independent assay results. Trustified is used for discovery; a report on a different batch or formulation does not certify this offer.
offer.notes: Exact selected Fruit Fusion1kg jar and flavour-specific nutrition panel reviewed. One15g scoop declares1.5g creatineHCl,46.5kcal,500mg taurine,375mg leucine,187mg valine,188mg isoleucine,66.6mg sodium,21.2mg potassium and1.5mg magnesium. Per100g label declares10g creatineHCl and310kcal; a second30g serving is also printed but does not replace the chosen one-scoop15g basis. Contains dextrose and77.51g carbohydrate per100 g. HCl mass is compound mass, not free-creatine equivalent. Manufacturer wording such as superior absorption/no bloating/advanced or elite dosing is not treated as an established efficacy advantage or a personalised recommendation.
offer.formulation: Creatine, dextrose, BCAA, taurine and mineral blend
offer.productReviewReason: HCl compound plus dextrose, BCAAs, taurine and minerals; review whole formulation and cumulative amino-acid/mineral exposure. Not treated as equivalent to plain monohydrate.
